name: CreateWorkflow

parameters.help_en: The JSON string of task dependencies, which contains the dependencies among all tasks in the workflow. preTaskId indicates the ID of the upstream task, and postTaskId indicates the ID of the downstream task. The task ID specified here is a custom ID and cannot be 0. Each task must have a unique ID. If a task node does not have an upstream task, you must add a dependency with preTaskId set to 0
parameters.help_zh: 任务依赖关系json，包含工作流所有任务之间的依赖关系，preTaskId为上游任务id，postTaskId为下游任务id，此处指定的任务id为自定义id（不能为0），每一个任务需有唯一的id。如果任务节点没有上游任务，也需要增加一个preTaskId为0的依赖关系
parameters.name: task_relation_json
